neighbours.label: A noun naming what a sensor, test or instrument detects, as the modifier in a compound (smell sensors, urine drug screens, pressure gauge); broad, so near misses fire weakly
fire: The robot arm carries a gas sensor and a vibration detector.
Athletes must pass a steroid test before each tournament.
Mechanics checked the oil gauge and the temperature probe.
Our office installed a smoke alarm and a motion sensor.
The clinic offers a glucose monitor and a pregnancy test.
Inspectors brought a radon kit and a moisture meter.
Divers rely on a depth gauge and an oxygen monitor.
Airport staff use a metal detector and a sniffer swab.
quiet: The robot arm carries a steel plate and a rubber wheel.
Athletes must eat a large breakfast before each tournament.
Mechanics checked the front door and the back window.
Our office installed a green carpet and a glass table.
The clinic offers a warm blanket and a quiet room.
Inspectors brought a paper form and a black pen.
Divers rely on a good friend and an old boat.
Airport staff use a wide corridor and a side entrance.

short: what a sensor or test detects
